full_judgment: 22. He lastly submits that learned Appellate Tribunal and Labour Court failed to appreciate that the BLL Case is defective for misjoinder and/or for non-joinder of parties in as much as borrower was a necessary party and Rupali Bank Limited was neither necessary party nor a proper party in the case and, as such, the judgment and order is illegal and declared to have been passed without lawful authority and is of no legal effect.
